searchText: Some rendered examples: https://ethereum.github.io/execution-specs/diffs/frontier_homestead/vm/instructions/system/index.html https://ethereum.github.io/execution-specs/diffs/frontier_homestead/spec/index.html#calculate-intrinsic-cost FYI: mobile rendering isn't great. Functional, but broken in a number of places. Likely not a high priority at this point I suspect. Anything in particular? I can try to upstream any fixes. lol, yep, that's pretty different than my phone. That is zoomed all the way out, you start out zoomed in with a horizontal scrollbar. Ah, okay. So it's mostly text wrapping issues? And the bullets? At the top, yes. That top line is triggering a very wide window rendering but the rest of the page has a fixed width it appears. This is Android Firefox. Oh incidentally: very handwavy and easily misinterpreted description of delegatecall >.> Yeah, all the english documentation is pretty sparse That is on the second link, text isn't properly contained within its bounding box (expected overflow truncation and scrollbar on the bounding box). I'm not sure what that is supposed to be rendered like, but it looks bad as is. 😄 That part is still in progress the diffs are brand new The most acceptable answer IMO. 🙂
